t: When you are losing and it shows
a: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
p: Wa lā tahinū wa lā taḥzanū wa antumu-l-aʿlawna in kuntum mu'minīn.
m: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
